title: Dependence uncertainty: a decision-theoretic approach
abstract: arXiv:2503.13416v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Individual risks are often better understood than their dependence. We axiomatize choice under dependence uncertainty on finite product state spaces. Preferences reveal utility and marginal beliefs, while acts are evaluated by an act-dependent weighting of worst- and best-case expected utility over all joint distributions consistent with the marginals. We characterize independence-based behavior, which may reflect either justified beliefs or correlation neglect, and introduce dependence premia as well as a comparative ordering of dependence aversion. We classify acts by their exposure to dependence and characterize independence axioms under which the worst-best weight is constant within each class. Finally, we characterize the geometry and extreme points of the dependence uncertainty set, connecting the behavioral analysis to a copula perspective that does not require real-valued random variables.

translated_title: 相依不确定性：一种决策理论方法
translated_abstract: 个体风险往往比它们之间的相依关系更容易被理解。本文在有限乘积状态空间上对相依不确定性下的选择行为进行公理化。偏好揭示出效用与边际信念，而行为（acts）则通过一种依行为而定的加权方式来评估，该加权针对所有与给定边际分布一致的联合分布，权衡最坏情形与最好情形的期望效用。我们刻画了基于独立性的行为——它既可能反映有依据的信念，也可能反映相关性忽视——并引入了相依溢价（dependence premia）以及相依厌恶的比较排序。我们依据行为对相依性的暴露程度对其进行分类，并刻画了使最坏-最好权重在每一类内保持恒定的独立性公理。最后，我们刻画了相依不确定性集合的几何结构与极点，将行为分析与一种无需实值随机变量的copula视角联系起来。
tldr: 本文公理化刻画了相依不确定性下的决策行为，用基于边际分布的所有联合分布上的最坏-最好期望效用加权来评估行为，引入相依溢价与相依厌恶排序，并通过copula视角揭示了相依不确定性集合的几何结构。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatizes choice under dependence uncertainty by evaluating acts through act-dependent worst-best weightings of expected utility over all joint distributions consistent with the marginals, introducing dependence premia and comparative dependence aversion, and connecting the behavioral analysis to a copula-based geometric characterization of the dependence uncertainty set.
